id.description: The id of the underlying {@link ExMachina} service.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

status.description: The status of the ExMachina service. Maintained by {@link ExMachinaInstance.Status.Controller#updateStatuses}

settings.description: A reference to the instance settings, including driver/executor sizing details. Persisted for billing.

session.description: The parent {@link ExMachinaSession} to which this instance is assigned

title:
ExMachinaInstance refers to a single {@link ExMachina} service. It provides metadata including availability status,
memory settings, and start/stop times, and simplifies orchestration of ExMachina services.
name: ExMachinaInstance
